note: Import Gate I4: no free text. Where a venue has courts of more than one surface, record the surface of the majority of its pickleball courts and describe the rest in amenities or pricing_notes. Multi-surface handling is an OPEN decision in decisions.md.

values.asphalt: Bituminous pavement, usually line-striped, with no acrylic colour coating.
values.concrete: Poured concrete slab with no acrylic colour coating.
values.acrylic: Acrylic colour coating over an asphalt or concrete base. The most common dedicated outdoor pickleball surface.
values.cushioned_acrylic: Acrylic colour coating over a rubberised cushion layer, softer underfoot than plain acrylic.
values.modular_tile: Interlocking polypropylene tiles laid over a hard base.
values.wood: Indoor hardwood, typically a shared gymnasium floor with pickleball lines.
values.synthetic_indoor: Rolled or poured synthetic indoor sport surface such as vinyl or polyurethane.
values.clay: Clay or Har-Tru. Rare, generally a converted tennis facility.
values.grass: Natural grass or artificial turf. Rare and usually temporary.
